name: replacement_bus_contract_for_closed_tram_section
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-86, from Run 45558738725: Sheffield tram section closed after a mineshaft was found under the track, The Star): the news is the replacement bus service for a closed tram section, its contract and daily cost.

candidates.title: Replacement buses for closed tram section cost thousands a day
candidates.search_snippet: Replacement buses for closed tram section cost thousands a day.
candidates.source_content: Replacement buses serving an area cut off from the tram network since an old mineshaft was found under the tracks are costing several thousand pounds a day. The authority awarded the replacement bus service to a bus operator after a competitive tender, and the contract runs until the end of December. The tram section will stay closed until the ground under the tracks has been made safe.
